1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi babwirisha inanga ijwi ryitwa “Witsemba.” Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi yitwa Mikitamu, yahimbye ubwo Sawuli yatumaga bakarindira inzu kugira ngo bamwice.

2.text: Mana yanjye, unkize abanzi banjye,Unshyire hejuru y'abampagurukira.

4.text: Kuko bubikira ubugingo bwanjye,Abanyambaraga bateraniye kuntera,Kandi ntazize igicumuro cyanjye,Cyangwa icyaha cyanjye, Uwiteka.

5.text: Barirukanka bakitegura batagize icyo bampora,Kanguka unsanganire ubirebe.

6.text: Ni wowe mpamagara, Uwiteka,Mana Nyiringabo, Mana y'Abisirayeli,Kangukira guhana abapagani bose,Ntugire abanyabicumuro babi ubabarira.Sela.

8.text: Dore badudubiranya amagambo mabi mu kanwa kabo,Inkota ziri mu minwa yabo,Kuko bibaza bati “Ni nde ubyumva?”

9.text: Ariko wowe Uwiteka uzabaseka,Uzakoba abapagani bose.

10.text: Wa mbaraga yanjye we, nzagutegereza,Kuko Imana ari yo gihome kirekire kinkingira.

11.text: Imana mboneramo imbabazi izansanganira,Imana izanyereka ibyo nshakira abanyubikira.

12.text: Ntubice kugira ngo abantu banjye batabyibagirwa,Mwami ngabo idukingira,Ubatatanishe imbaraga zawe ubacishe bugufi.

13.text: Ijambo ryose ryo mu minwa yabo ni igicumuro cy'akanwa kabo,Ubwibone bwabo bubafate nk'umutego,Imivumo n'ibinyoma bavuga na byo bibafatishe.

14.text: Ubatsembane umujinya,Ubatsembe be kubaho ukundi,Kugeza ku mpera y'isi hose,Bamenye yuko Imana itegeka Abayakobo.Sela.

15.text: Ba bandi bajye bagaruka nimugoroba bakankame nk'imbwa,Bazenguruke umudugudu.

17.text: Ariko jyeweho nzaririmba imbaraga zawe,Kuko wambereye igihome kirekire kinkingira.Mu gitondo nzaririmbisha imbabazi zawe ijwi rirenga,N'ubuhungiro ku munsi w'amakuba yanjye.

18.text: Ni wowe wa mbaraga yanjye we, nzaririmbira ishimwe,Kuko Imana ari yo gihome kirekire kinkingira,Ni Imana mboneramo imbabazi.
